note: All 51 concept sheets were directly reviewed with final02 actual six-view captures. For final03, the four changed objects were directly compared again, and the other 47 objects underwent decoded RGBA pixel comparison. All 11 objects with any pixel difference were visually rechecked in all six final03 views. Remaining differences from concepts are disclosed per object; no numeric concept-similarity score is claimed.
followup_scene_finding: Closed actual room corner/floor/ceiling gaps with full-span recessed cores and opaque perimeter seals. A rejected 94% core intersected stone; accepted 75% cores preserve the facades. Six arch headers and four wall/ceiling closures use the same non-colliding wall family. The hearth now has round charred logs, hollow rounded pot/cup, curved handles and a continuous low stone foundation; actual vertex normal checks caught and corrected the vessel winding.

pixel_consistency.note: Five objects contain animated effects. The six other objects differ by only 1–1,060 pixels across six views; all eleven latest sheets were visually reviewed, with no new geometry/material discrepancy identified.
